purpose: Separate remaining three summer backpack shape references for owner Tripo generation, matching the approved wardrobe concept.

generations.prompt:
Create ONE SINGLE BACKPACK as a large clean standalone 3D MODELING REFERENCE for Tripo, based on the indicated SUMMER backpack from the provided approved Bloomlings accessory catalog. The catalog is only a design reference; do NOT reproduce its layout. Exactly ONE complete object, no other accessories, no character, no mannequin, no text, no labels, no stand or props.

FORM-FIRST REFERENCE: all parts in ONE SAME LIGHT NEUTRAL GRAY matte clay material. No colored parts, painted patterns, fabric weave, fuzzy texture, realistic leather grain, stitch patterns or metallic reflections. Soft even neutral studio lighting with gentle continuous geometric shading and subtle contact shadow. Plain white background. The entire backpack centered at about 80 percent of SQUARE canvas height, fully visible with generous margins. Front three-quarter product view slightly from above, so the decorated FRONT, a SIDE, TOP HANDLE and rear shoulder strap loops are understandable. Minimal perspective distortion.

Premium cute stylized mobile garden game design: compact upright body, large simple readable sculpted details, rounded edges and smooth clean surfaces, no excessive small ornament. Preserve each selected backpack's DISTINCT geometric identity from the catalog rather than recoloring a generic bag. Main body height about 1.2 times width, depth about half width; front softly convex, rear flatter, rounded corners and broad nearly flat bottom. Not a sphere or giant bulbous sack.

Every backpack must have exactly TWO broad flat rounded-edge shoulder straps attached near upper back corners and lower back corners. Straps form two smooth separate untwisted open loops with visibly empty gaps, not fused to body along their whole length, not crossed and not extra handles. Exactly ONE smaller short centered inverted-U top carry handle with a clear open hole under it. No long crossbody strap or third shoulder strap. Any flowers, petals, shells, clasp ornaments are REAL relief geometry, not a texture or decal. Clear part boundaries, simple buildable geometry.

SELECT BLOOM'S SUMMER BACKPACK: the CREAM AND PINK PETAL BACKPACK in second hero column, first seasonal row, to the right of pink glasses. Recreate its exact flower-themed shapes in neutral gray.
Compact rounded rectangular main body, narrow side gussets, a slightly domed top. Main decorative UPPER FLAP is formed by a fan of several BROAD OVERLAPPING FLOWER PETALS cascading downward from the upper center toward front and upper sides. Petals have smooth softly convex surfaces, wide rounded outer tips, gently tapered attachment ends, modest visible thickness and only one broad shallow center crease if any. The central lower petal points downward with a rounded point, side petals spread diagonally downward. Petals overlap near their roots, not a spiky palm leaf and not a ring of thin pointed leaves. Preserve this distinctive draped flower-petal collar flap from the summer reference.
Below the petal flap, a small low-profile softly rounded front pocket. A single SMALL raised daisy sits at upper center of pocket: FIVE thick rounded oval petals around ONE domed circular center. Daisy about one-quarter body width, not covering entire backpack. Subtle shallow broad vertical panel borders on lower front, smooth side panels. Keep the leaf-vein Sprig design OUT of this bag: use rounded flower petals, no long leaf veins. Rear shoulder straps and top handle have same neat rounded geometry as common specification. No ribbons, bows, extra flowers or dangling ornaments.

SELECT DROP'S SUMMER BACKPACK: the AQUA AND CREAM SHELL BACKPACK in third hero column, first seasonal row, to the right of blue glasses. Recreate its exact aquatic shapes in neutral gray.
Distinct body silhouette with a strongly ROUND DOMED TOP and straighter lower sides, flat rounded base, slightly narrower upper shoulders. Simple smooth broad top/back shell and restrained side gussets.
One low projecting FRONT POCKET occupies lower front. Its face bears ONE LARGE SCALLOP SEASHELL in raised geometry, centered and about half the body width. Shell is a broad fan shape: FIVE or SIX thick rounded convex radiating lobes widen upward from a small narrow root at bottom. Upper scalloped outline has broad rounded tips, no spikes. Clean shallow valleys between lobes radiate continuously toward the bottom root, no tiny serrations, no realistic rough shell surface. The bottom of shell has two small smooth rounded attachment lobes at most. Shell is firmly attached to pocket, no loose shell prop.
Two narrow raised side piping strips frame the bag's front edge, simple smooth shapes not stitches. Near upper visible side, one small oval side opening/loop detail from the reference, with actual open hole and clear rim, not a transparent area. Exactly two shoulder loops and one short top handle. NO flower, leaf flap, acorn, face, water splash, bubbles or hanging trinkets. Distinctively a clean little shell backpack, not a backpack shaped as an entire seashell.

Main body is a compact softly rounded rectangular satchel-like backpack, broad flat lower face, nearly flat back and modest depth. A large broad rounded U-shaped UPPER FLAP folds down over upper half of front; smooth simple flap, NOT leaf-shaped and NOT flower-petal shaped. A second smaller rounded rectangular reinforcement tab lies vertically at top center of flap and connects into a single central closure strap. The closure strap descends down front center and ends at a little ACORN-SHAPED CLASP near flap's lower center.
Acorn clasp is a small distinct three-dimensional relief, about one-quarter body width: rounded tapered lower nut with short soft downward point and two broad shallow vertical grooves; upper cap dome slightly wider than nut, with THREE OR FOUR large simple overlapping rounded scale panels, no fine crosshatch. Acorn attached to center strap, not floating. No extra green leaf ornament.
Body front framed by a thick smooth rounded perimeter border/piping strip continuing around base; visible shallow low-profile front panel/pocket beneath flap, no extra front ornament. Smooth side gussets and simple small shoulder strap attachment pads only. Two broad shoulder strap loops behind, one short top handle as specified. No climbing gear, metal buckles, zippers, multiple small pockets or long dangling belts. This is a miniature friendly forest explorer backpack, NOT the acorn-shaped autumn crossbody bag.
